title: Cisco Reports Q1 Fiscal 2027 Earnings on $18.5 Billion Revenue
summary: Cisco reported fiscal Q1 2027 revenue of $18.5 billion, up 24%, and non-GAAP EPS of $1.40, and raised its fiscal 2027 revenue and non-GAAP EPS guidance.
body_markdown:
Product revenue rose 32% and services revenue rose 1%, with Networking up 43%, the release said. GAAP operating margin was 30.2% and non-GAAP operating margin was 37.8%. Cisco also declared a quarterly dividend of $0.42 per common share.


For the second quarter of fiscal 2027, Cisco expects revenue of $18.0 billion to $18.2 billion, GAAP EPS of $1.07 to $1.09 and non-GAAP EPS of $1.34 to $1.36. CNBC reported an LSEG average revenue estimate of $17.88 billion for that quarter. For fiscal 2027, the company now expects revenue of $74.8 billion to $75.8 billion, GAAP EPS of $4.38 to $4.44 and non-GAAP EPS of $5.47 to $5.53.


## Why It Matters for CSCO


Cisco said the quarter delivered its strongest revenue and non-GAAP EPS growth rates in over 15 years, and that revenue, non-GAAP operating margin and non-GAAP EPS all exceeded the high end of its guidance ranges. The company reported double-digit growth across all geographies, with the Americas up 28%, EMEA up 18% and APJC up 21%. It also raised its expectation for AI infrastructure revenue from hyperscalers to $9 billion in fiscal 2027, which it said is more than double the total for fiscal 2026.
